ctx.x: In June, I participated in another French Festival located in Normandy, in a village called Luneray. This festival was taking place in a potato storage barn, and there was an attendance of 10,000 people in those days. Plenty of amateur bands were there, and 4 or 5 professional ones. Also, 2 or 3 wellknown artists as attraction. The music was non-stop from 10 in the morning until 9 in the evening. People could eat and drink there at a very moderate price. The organisation was super and all the people of the…

The 21st of June, I did a concert in Joinville, a suburb of Paris with Benny Carter, Ben Webster, Kenny Drew, Art Taylor, Michel Sarbadi, Johnny Griffin, The Golden Gate Quartet. I could only make one concert because I had to leave the next day for Morocco, but there were going to be three concerts in the same theatre, the 21st, 22nd, and 23rd. On the programme would also be Claude Bolling, Memphis Slim, Slide Hampton, The Delta Rhytmn Boys. The festival was organized and sponsored by a woman named Lallie…

In Morocco, I went in Tanger to give a concert. The band leader was Jacques Largeaud and he had an amateur drummer who was a native from one of the oldest African tribes in Morocco, whose name was Slim. Slim had a very shabby set of drums.
